run_vanilla_sweep: run the vanilla_sweep function to generate ensemble configurations with 1, 3, 10, 30, and 100 ensemble members
run_weight_sweep: run the weight_sweep function to generate ensemble configs with varying l2 weight decay and adaptive weight scale settings
run_combined_sweep: run the combined_sweep function to get both vanilla and weight sweep ensemble configurations
run_paper_agent: run the paper_agent function to create a PaperAgent with default ensemble config, make_agent ctor, and combined sweep
review_ensemble_sweep: review the ensemble sweep module that provides vanilla, weight, and combined sweeps for neural testbed ensemble agents
